title: Start dancing Kizomba TODAY! Dance tutorial for beginners

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the basic stance and weight distribution principles for Kizomba, then systematically breaks down three fundamental steps (Basic 1, Basic 2, and Basic 3) from multiple angles and with music.
method.signature: Emphasizing weight placement strictly on the balls of the feet rather than the heels, and prohibiting hip swinging or marching to maintain authentic Kizomba technique.

practices.what: Explains and demonstrates the Basic 1 step with weight shifts and proper posture.
Practices Basic 1 along with music at a slow tempo.
Breaks down Basic 2 stepping to the side and returning to a neutral center position.
Practices Basic 2 step along with music.
Introduces and breaks down Basic 3 step involving two steps forward and a reset.
Practices Basic 3 step along with music.

beliefs.belief: The basic steps are the same for everyone, regardless of who is leading or following.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the basic stance and posture for Kizomba, explaining how to align body parts.
The teacher explains that weight should stay on the ball of the foot rather than the heels.
The teacher breaks down the first basic step with detailed instructions on leg relaxation and weight shifts.
The teacher demonstrates what not to do by showing the incorrect way to lift heels and compare it to marching.
The teacher introduces basic two with side steps and weight shifts, explaining the concept of marca.
The teacher encourages the learner as they dance basic two with music.
The teacher praises the learner for a good job and offers a reminder to keep paying attention to every single step.
The teacher reminds the learner to like, subscribe, and leave comments with questions.
The teacher explains the mechanics of basic three, emphasizing relaxation and avoiding weight changes on the third step.
The teacher dances basic three along with music and congratulates the learner on a good job.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable, focused, and ready to master Kizomba fundamentals step by step.

struggles.theme: Getting humbled or confused by other mixed styles of kizomba

clicked.theme: Finally understanding authentic hip movement and foundation technique

requests.theme: Asking for more tutorials covering the entire dance

meant.theme: Feeling confident to join dance groups and remove overwhelm

method.limits: The video focuses entirely on solo beginner footwork and posture without a live partner demonstration of the full variations.
